select_precision.p99_convention: nearest rank: ceil(0.99 n)-th smallest absolute error
select_precision.stats_convention: absolute_error_us/signed_error_us are clrt_check.stats (index round(q(n-1))), reported only; the gate is p99

operate_precision.p99_convention: nearest rank: ceil(0.99 n)-th smallest absolute error
operate_precision.stats_convention: absolute_error_us/signed_error_us are clrt_check.stats (index round(q(n-1))), reported only; the gate is p99

piggyback_latency.p99_convention: nearest rank: ceil(0.99 n)-th smallest rt_us
piggyback_latency.note: provisional objective: nearest-rank p99 of request-to-response (rt_us, master request on out.pcap to response on in.pcap, the same Vision NIC clock) over piggybacked exchanges <= pb + margin; up to 1% of samples may exceed it, so it is not a maximum guarantee. Response availability at the outstation is not observed by this verdict.

observation.includes: path and capture delay; not an ASIC residency timestamp

continuation.reason: READ p99 absolute error threshold only

restore.step: cold-swap bf_switchd back to the observed production program
replay the pre-run $PORT snapshot on the production program
Vision: fixture off, namespace profile and NIC flag restored
ping through the restored switch path

fixture.note: Two workloads, run and reported separately. separate_ack = vision_run.py casea on --delay-ms delay_ms (emulated relay: a separate ACK, then a delayed response, as the SEL-751 does). piggyback = casea off (the endpoint's natural ~0.3 ms response with the ACK on the response). readiness must exceed delay_ms + readiness_margin_ms or the delayed child response misses the readiness deadline (audit defect D); that is a warning. jitter is not implemented by vision_run.py, so any non-zero jitter_ms is rejected.

traffic.master_port_note: Three successive connections on this same installed tuple; one cold bring-up, no register clear or reseed.
traffic.start_delay_note: maximum pre-connect delay in ms; each trial applies a seeded uniform draw in 0..N (seed = seeds.rng_seed + trial number, recorded). 0 = connect immediately.

endpoint_identity._lib_note: lib_sha256 is the sha256 of the sorted `sha256sum` listing of every file under lib/
endpoint_identity._pin_with: sha256sum case4_socket_gate_pad58b; sorted sha256sum listing hash under lib/ in the configured Vision directory
endpoint_identity._pinned: repeat_sbo_endpoint fork (CASE4_SBO_CYCLES, append-only per-command records); software handler only.
